llms:
Formula rowWeights[row] = fixed_tree_sum(sortedContributions[begin:end]): one workgroup per stored origin-destination pair sums the pair's contributions (the weights of its records, in source row order, 0 for rejected or non-finite weights) with a strided partial sum and a fixed binary tree, so the float sum is bitwise reproducible. It is a sum of the weights (trips), not a mean and not the record count; flowCounts counts the records of the pair separately.
